name: Victoria
tagline: Garden city of whales and afternoon tea
summary: Victoria, British Columbia's capital on Vancouver Island, is a mild, flower-filled city around a pretty Inner Harbour. See the Butchart Gardens, take afternoon tea at the Fairmont Empress, go whale watching for orcas and explore the Royal BC Museum.
seasonNote: Summer is sunny and whale season peaks May to October.
arrival: Ferry or floatplane from Vancouver; Victoria Airport is 25 minutes away.
gettingAround: Walk the harbour; buses and harbour ferries.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 15 to 20 percent. Sales tax is added at the till.
